notes.title: ARTE celebrates 10 years of video games
notes.notes:
This October, we are celebrating 10 years working alongside talented artists and creators to come up with unique and original games!

To mark this milestone, we’re having a massive sale including all of our game catalogue, with discount going from 30% to 80% off!

Thank you for getting on this journey with us, here’s to many more games ! 🎂

Whether you are new to the ARTE Experience or have been there since the beginning, we want to thank you and let you know more about what’s to come, so stay tuned for all the big things to come !

notes.title: Gloomy Eyes is now on sale!
notes.notes:
"When the sun got tired of human stupidity, it decided to disappear never to rise again.” 

Voiced by Colin farrell, [i]Gloomy Eyes[/i] is an animated VR-trilogy in 6DoF & 3D real-time. coproduced with Atlas V, 3DAR and Ryot. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36925920/f7eca6b7e89705dadafec7bd253ac6aad1fb0378.png[/img]

One day, the sun set and never rose again. The darkness awoke the dead from their graves, forced to hide in the forest, away from dangerous zombie hunters.
Gloomy is a zombie kid unlike any other: he falls in love with a human girl. Can their love survive in a world where the living and the dead cannot peacefully coexist?

🧟💚👱‍♀️

[b]Gloomy eyes is now 60% off![/b]

notes.title: Groundbreaking Atlas V Immersive Studio at Virtual Comic Con 2020, July 22 - 26
notes.notes:
Atlas V, co-producers of Gloomy Eyes with 3DAR, Arte France, RYOT, and HTC Vive Originals, are featured at the international and virtual Comic Con 2020!
Exhibiting immersive content by a global community of creators, powered by Unity, you can explore new worlds in mixed reality, unleash your imagination, and create some magic. 

Gloomy Eyes episode 1 is available during Comic Con to all attendees! This project joins the rest of the Atlas V catalog at their virtual booth, which invites you to jump into immersive narratives made by independent artists and creators from all over the world!

notes.title: Gloomy Eyes celebrates release on Oculus Quest
notes.notes:
We are so excited to share that the VR film that star Colin Farrell calls "one of the most beautiful things" he has ever been a part of, is now available on Oculus Quest!

Dive into the fantastically eerie and adorably spinning world of Gloomy, a boy zombie different from all the others - one with a heart that yearns for love. In a world flooded with darkness, it is the unexpected connection between a human girl and a zombie boy that inspires hope in all of us. 

Gloomy Eyes holds multiple awards from renowned film festivals across the world including Sundance, Annecy, SXSW, Annie Awards, Venice International, and Raindance.
